issues: The 'Made with Emergent' platform badge overlaps with the NeedHelpFab (need-help-btn). Both use fixed bottom-right positioning. Real-user click works (badge sits slightly lower-right) but overlap is visually crowded; manual testing needed JS-dispatched click to bypass for automation. Suggest moving the FAB to bottom: 4.5rem or right: 5.5rem on production preview to give the badge airspace.

action_items: LOW: Reposition NeedHelpFab so it does not collide with the 'Made with Emergent' badge in preview deployments (either bottom-24 right-6 or right-24).
critical_code_review_comments: asset_master.py is a clean static module — auth-gated via get_current_user; tenant-agnostic since the master library is global. 7 categories × 3-5 templates = 24 templates, comfortably above the >=20 requirement.

qr.py uses BytesIO + reportlab.canvas correctly; PDFs streamed via Response with proper Content-Disposition; tenant_filter applied on both /qr/asset/{id} and /qr/sheet — verified demo cannot fetch acme QR.

qr.qr_sheet preserves request order via by_id reorder loop; assets dict 500-doc cap is reasonable for a print sheet (would warn in code review only if asset_ids could exceed 500 — current MASTER + UI flow won't).

_build_pdf branches by layout 1 / 10 / 20 with distinct cell geometry; multi-page handled via showPage() when idx_in_page wraps — verified PDF size grew from ~3KB (1 asset) to >>3KB (12 assets, 2 pages on layout=10).

HelpCenter role visibility filter (HELP.tabs.filter t.roles.includes(role||'all')) — works correctly for all 3 roles tested. fire_officer / auditor visibility was not exercised because we have only client_admin/technician/super_admin credentials in test_credentials.md; recommend adding officer@acme.in test in next iteration.
i18n via window event 'fos-lang' is a clean cross-component sync mechanism; localStorage fos_lang persists choice across reloads.
NeedHelpFab is mounted in AppShell and uses portal-less fixed positioning — collides with Emergent platform badge in preview env (see design_issues).
Assets.jsx Print QR button text reactively shows '(N)' selection count — good UX hint.
test_credentials: All 4 accounts in /app/memory/test_credentials.md verified working. Used: superadmin@sspl.in, admin@acme.in, tech@acme.in, demo@fire-os.in (auto-created via POST /api/demo/login).
seed_data_creation: No new seed needed — /api/asset-master is static; QR tests reused existing Acme assets (70+ TEST_* assets carried over from Phase 1-3 fixtures).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite now has 5 files in /app/backend/tests/: backend_test.py (34) + test_stabilization.py (18) + test_phase2.py (13) + test_phase3.py (21) + test_phase4.py (14) = 100 cases. Run all with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://fire-safety-engine.preview.emergentagent.com MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=fire_compliance_os pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Phase-4 single QR / sheet routes are stateless — no DB writes, idempotent. Frontend FAB has overlay collision with the 'Made with Emergent' platform badge — automation must use JS-dispatched click. Public /terms is the only Phase-4 unauth route besides /, /login. The 'wallet exhausted' Hinglish toast was code-reviewed only (would require draining Acme wallet to 0 via pymongo and asset POST → would need a fresh top-up after; intentionally skipped to keep prior fixtures clean).

rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found; all assertions PASS. The only operational note is the FAB ↔ Emergent badge overlap in preview which is a deployment-cosmetic issue, not a functional defect.
